continuity.arc_goal: Transform Keiro from quiz-based to reading-first Japanese learning app. Users read real Japanese from day one with thematic curriculum, i+1 sentence selection, dynamic sessions, furigana toggle, and image exercises. Success metric: read Yotsuba at 80% comprehension after completing N3 path.

constraints: Tatoeba quality: only 1.6% of JP-EN pairs are fully verified — aggressive filtering needed
EDRDG license: not OSI, commercial use requires contacting EDRDG — mitigate by open-sourcing content package
Furigana accuracy ~95-98% with kuromoji/kuroshiro — acceptable for MVP
No official JLPT word lists — using Jonathan Waller/Tanos community standard
Images: Unsplash ToS prohibits bundling, use Wikimedia Commons CC0 instead
decisions: Vertical Slice approach: build Self-Introduction topic end-to-end before scaling
Tatoeba + EDRDG for sentences, no LLM generation (reliability concern per user)
Pre-computed furigana at build time with kuroshiro + @sglkc/kuromoji
Thematic curriculum within JLPT levels — topics like Animals, Family, Food instead of abstract type blocks
risks: Tatoeba filtering may yield too few usable sentences for pilot topic
Thematic reorganization is large — phased to pilot first
CC BY-SA on EDRDG data needs legal review for commercial
